author: coinkong
text: Hunting a kernel bug used to be one expert, one bug, weeks of work. OpenAI ran it as a process instead. The pipeline scans the Linux kernel for suspicious spots, breaks a real machine running stock Linux to prove the spot is real.

author: keithrull
text: Cyber is Critical — and labs are accelerating with AI in the loop. GPT-6 Cyber ships under Daybreak Red; METR: Anthropic ~2x faster on task progress; Claude Enterprise inference hooks go GA

author: severitydaily
text: Craft CMS proved an unauthenticated SQL injection could set the admin flag, rated it High, and gave it no CVE. VulnCheck (@VulnCheckAI) scored it 9.8 today, 50 days after the fix. No exploitation reported.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: High · Patched Avast/AVG/Norton 26.7: sandbox escapes and WFP stream-parser crash (CVE-2026-80301–80303) CVE-2026-80302, CVE-2026-80303 Fixed in: 26.7

author: ExpComputer
text: Security flaw could expose ChatGPT conversations to data theft and malware attacks

author: hazemomier
text: Kyverno CVE-2026-122313 (critical): NamespacedMutatingPolicy authors can reach other namespaces' resources via the background controller's cluster SA. Upgrade to 1.19.2+.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: High · Patched Symfony Serializer: UploadedFile / data-URI denormalization can read arbitrary server files (CVE-2026-118515, CVE-2026-121623) Fixed in: 5.4.56, 6.4.50, 7.4.23, 8.1.11

author: stretchcloud
text: OpenAI rated GPT-6 Cyber Critical for cybersecurity on November 4, the first time any of its released models crossed that line under the Preparedness Framework. The model is restricted to a small set of approved Daybreak Red customers through the API and Codex.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: Public exploit released: CVE-2026-118423 (CVSS 10.0) Unknown WP Libre Form · Remote code execution Remote, no login needed. The WP Libre Form WordPress plugin 1.5.0.1 does not validate the type of files uploaded through its form.

author: a16z
text: AI can now help turn a published fix into a working exploit in hours. Patching still takes weeks, and for many old routers, cameras, and supermarket fridges, a fix never arrives.

author: EvelynOnSec
text: CISA warns of active in-the-wild exploitation of a critical GitLab unauthenticated RCE flaw—patch immediately.

author: AIWorkfloway
text: OpenAI unveiled GPT-6 Cyber, an AI hacker—the model has been assigned the highest threat level. It can independently search for and exploit vulnerabilities even in systems with very strong security. It was this model that wrote working exploits for 948 vulnerabilities.

author: EvelynOnSec
text: CISA added WordPress Core RCE flaw CVE-2026-119977 to KEV—patch now before peripheral blogs become corporate backdoors.

author: DominicKramerr
text: LLMs can find sooooo many vulnerabilities in any complex real-world codebase, and one of the additional AI problems we face now is to use AI to prioritize which of these.

author: Gruve_ai
text: Gruve's CXO AI DailySignal - November 6, 2026 Nearly 37,000 software vulnerabilities were disclosed in the third quarter, triple a year earlier, as companies moved to continuous AI-assisted detection and patching.

author: CRudinschi
text: Three critical zero-day vulnerabilities in a patch management platform allowed unauthenticated remote code execution across enterprises in early 2026. CISA flagged them as Known Exploited Vulnerabilities. Partner content with @OPSWAT.

author: 3WEBBOX
text: Attackers now use autonomous AI frameworks to turn one compromised identity into a cloud-wide breach in minutes. Static IAM roles & perimeter firewalls won't stop automated lateral movement.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-123488 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.8 Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.9 and 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the element search endpoint.

author: trustedciso
text: Anthropic says an unreleased Claude model wrote a working zero-click remote root exploit for Linux flaw CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8) in about 53 minutes. As of Nov 4, neither Red Hat nor Ubuntu had shipped a fixed kernel.

author: Clone4105
text: Binance's $6.3B hack didn't start in the code. Binance says it started with a fake job interview and a compromised internal AI tool.

author: SadraMajidi04
text: CVE-2026-109518 (CVSS 7.7, High): an on-path attacker or malicious mirror can make APT install an unverified .deb and run code as root. Affected by default: Debian 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+.

author: YourDailyCVE
text: CVE-2024-27834 — Apple Pointer Authentication bypass, used by Russia-linked APT29. CVSS 5.5. KEV Nov 4. Due Nov 18. Who should care: anyone with Apple devices that skipped the May 2024 updates.

author: StartupHakk
text: An AI just wrote a working exploit that can take over a Linux server from across the internet. No password. No click. Just packets.

author: MohakBajaj5
text: claude code was putting some users' signed-in email into the user-agent on outbound curls. nobody hacked anything. edgar and wikipedia ask scrapers for a contact; the agent had an email in session context, so it volunteered it. anthropic shipped a privacy mitigation in 2.1.317

author: aviatrixtrc
text: A low-privileged authenticated user chaining CVE-2026-63017 and CVE-2026-63774 can escalate to admin access and execute unauthorized SQL commands inside Subnet Solutions PowerSYSTEM Center — targeting energy and critical manufacturing ICS networks.

author: n5s_ai
text: OpenAI released GPT 6 Cyber to vetted Daybreak Red customers to help security researchers find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them. The model already uncovered 81 high severity Firefox flaws and 588 new Linux kernel vulnerabilities.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Instatic before 0.0.21: MCP content read tools skipped the HTTP API's row checks, so a low-priv user could read other users' drafts (CVE-2026-121458). Upgrade to 0.0.21. MCP tools are a second API — same auth path, or don't ship them.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: mcp-go before 1.2.1 and ChatCLI before 1.215.2: MCP OAuth let the server name the token audience (CVE-2026-123272 / 123271). Upgrade. After ChatCLI upgrade, logout any untrusted MCP server and revoke the OAuth client.

text: New CVEs JetBrains CLion: 2 critical CVEs Worst: code execution in Safe Mode via Meson project settings (CVE-2026-123831)

author: Asteri_eth
text: CLAUDE CODE HAS BEEN SENDING YOUR EMAIL TO THE WEBSITES IT VISITS nobody hacked anything. it was sitting in the prompt the whole time every session Claude Code puts your login email into the model's instructions.

author: OmerYounus1
text: Warp's vendor breach exposed agent decision logs for ~1% of its 800k users — a week after OpenCode's API-key breach. Solo devs: where do your agent traces live?
